title: Public Wi-Fi locations
excerpt: City-operated Wi-Fi is named CityNet_Public. Hotspots are marked at Upper Station, the Low Market, and the Seawall.

title: Lantern Night market hours
excerpt: The Low Market is open until 11:00 PM for Lantern Night. Some stalls may close earlier if they sell out.

title: Still here, still cooking
excerpt: Yes, we’re open tonight. You’re the fourth person whose phone said we weren’t.

title: CityNet Free
excerpt: Free Wi-Fi connection in the Flats. Sign in with your city account to continue.

title: Login request at the Flats
excerpt: Connected to CityNet Free and got a city-account login screen. I couldn’t find that network on the city’s hotspot map.

title: Dinner at Calla
excerpt: Two seats available at 7:15 PM. A short walk from Upper Station.

title: Lantern Night return passes
excerpt: Skip the line for ferry tickets at North Pier. Reserve your return pass before tonight’s crowds arrive. Get a pass at lanternbay-ferry.example.

title: Where to buy ferry tickets
excerpt: Buy tickets at the North Pier window or through ferry.lanternbay.example. These are our only ticket options.

title: About lanternbay-ferry.example
excerpt: This address was registered three days before Lantern Night. It is separate from ferry.lanternbay.example.

title: Is this my ferry pass?
excerpt: I paid for ferry tickets through the page my phone suggested, but the confirmation number doesn’t show up when I check it with Lantern Bay Ferry. Has anyone used it at the pier?

title: Lantern Night ferry departures
excerpt: North Pier departures tonight: 9:30 PM, 10:00 PM, and 10:45 PM. The 10:45 PM ferry is the last service of the night.

title: Ferry service extended for Lantern Night
excerpt: Ferries are running later than the usual weekday schedule for Lantern Night. Check Lantern Bay Ferry’s timetable before heading to North Pier.

title: Last ferry left at 10?
excerpt: Got to North Pier a little after ten and the last ferry was already gone. Don’t leave it too late.
